description.value: Kinkura Sushi + Sake is a Japanese restaurant on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, blending traditional sushi culture with a modern dining experience. The menu is extensive, covering salads, tempura, udon, teriyaki, sashimi, and a wide range of classic and specialty rolls including aburi (flame-seared) preparations. Online ordering is available, offering touring cyclists a convenient option for a quick Japanese meal in a dense, walkable neighbourhood.
